description: This file defines data models using Pydantic for a chess backend. It includes schemas for user creation, game state, moves, errors, snapshots, and related API request/response structures.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Schema for representing error messages with a human-readable detail.

classes.name: CreateUserRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user with a unique username.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Schema representing user information including ID, username, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: CreateGameRequest
classes.description: Schema for initiating a new game, optionally specifying white and black players.

classes.name: MoveResponse
classes.description: Schema representing a move made in a game including move details and timestamp.

classes.name: GameResponse
classes.description: Schema encapsulating the current state of a game, including move history and status.

classes.name: SubmitMoveRequest
classes.description: Schema for submitting a move, allowing UCI or SAN formats.

classes.name: SaveGameRequest
classes.description: Schema for saving the current game state as a snapshot with a name.

classes.name: LoadGameRequest
classes.description: Schema for loading a snapshot to restore game state.

classes.name: SnapshotResponse
classes.description: Schema for details about a game snapshot including FEN and move count.
